description:
Every CBP ruling that classifies goods under a code: for checking a code someone already
    has. `rulings` are current (not revoked), newest first, or closest to `product` first, each
    with what its goods were; `moved_away` are rulings CBP revoked off this code and the codes the
    revoking ruling put the goods under. If similar goods were moved away, the code is in doubt.

code.description: An HTS heading, subheading or line, 4 to 10 digits (8205, 8205.51, 8205.51.30.30). Old codes no longer in the schedule work too.
code.title: Code

offset.description: Rulings to skip, for the next page.
offset.title: Offset

product.description: Optional: the product in plain words, to put the rulings closest to it first.
product.title: Product

name: rulings_under_code
